general.title: General information
general.explainer: Company identity as on the commercial register. Feeds the cover page of your business plan.

investments.title: Investments
investments.explainer: Fixed assets (machinery, lines, software). Total CAPEX drives 7-year depreciation.

financing.title: Financing
financing.explainer: Equity / debt, up to 3 loan tranches, amortization schedule, annual summary and debt chart.

operations.title: Operations
operations.explainer: Production and unit cost assumptions. Drive revenue and gross margin by year.

timeline.title: Implementation timeline
timeline.explainer: Gantt chart (M1–M18), commercial start delay and milestones. Delay reduces year-1 revenue.

procurement.title: Procurement
procurement.explainer: Raw materials, BOMs, stock and purchase plan Y1–Y7. Feeds purchases, supplier WC and deductible VAT.

products.title: Products & pricing
products.explainer: Multi-product catalogue, rebates, Y2–Y7 growth and capacity utilisation.

pricing.title: Selling prices
pricing.explainer: Buy/sell vs. market grid, gross margin per product, price sensitivity.

productionCosts.title: Production costs
productionCosts.explainer: Unit cost per product (RM, packaging, energy, labour, depreciation, waste) and margin.

hr.title: Human resources
hr.explainer: Headcount and payroll. Social charges per Tunisian model rules.

otherCharges.title: Other operating expenses
otherCharges.explainer: Expenses by category (% revenue, % investment or flat, indexed over 7 years).

tva.title: VAT & tax
tva.explainer: VAT collected / deductible by category, supplier and customer balances, export table.

financial.title: Financial indicators
financial.explainer: Working capital, % of revenue charges and tax. Final step before validation.

fallback.hint: Value used in the 7-year plan calculation.
